title: FBI Photo B001
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white video/optical sighting screen capture with overlay graphics and redaction bars
pages.description: A grayscale image resembling a targeting or surveillance display with a grainy, noisy texture. A white crosshair reticle is centered in the frame, with a horizontal measurement scale marked with numbers 15, 10, 5, 0, 5, 10, 15 and tick marks, and a vertical scale with tick marks. Several black rectangular redaction bars are placed across the image: one large bar along the top, and three pairs of bars arranged on the left and right sides. In the lower portion of the image, faint mountain-like or terrain silhouettes are visible in darker gray tones. A white timestamp appears in the lower-left corner reading a date and time.
